prompt: Write a short passage about how your family celebrates a festival. Use adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, never).
promptCn: 写一段话讲你家怎么过一个节日。用频度副词(always, usually, often, sometimes, never)。
opener: My family always celebrates the festival together.

l1: I am never sad on that day.
l2: We usually eat {food}, and we always visit {who}.
We are never bored, and everyone is happy.
l3: My family always celebrates {festival} together. It is my favourite time of the year.
Before the day, we usually clean the house. We always eat {food}, and we often visit {who}.
In the evening, we sometimes {activity}, and we never forget to take photos.
We are never bored on this day. Our home is always full of love and laughter.
